server_url.semantics: operator supplied Gotify base URL; trailing slashes normalized; only http/https accepted

app_token.semantics: Gotify application token sent as X-Gotify-Key

behavior: Gotify appears as a normal alert channel type through the existing channel-management surface.
Creating a channel rejects unsupported type values as before and accepts gotify.
Updating a channel with the mask placeholder preserves the existing app_token.
Dispatch respects existing rule, cooldown and maintenance-window semantics unchanged.
Test-channel uses the same Gotify send path and emits one deterministic test notification.
Any HTTP 2xx is success; non-2xx is surfaced as channel-send failure under existing dispatch isolation.
Invalid server_url or missing app_token is surfaced as a channel configuration/send error.
No live Gotify server or internet access is required for the experimental oracle.
out_of_scope: new notification features beyond parity with the requested provider capability
